findings.note: CBS/RotoWire (Oct 11) confirms Rasmussen will start ALCS Game 1 against Cleveland, and says he struck out 10 Yankees over eight scoreless innings in his last start, the ALDS opener.

MLB.com says Rasmussen is fully rested and the Rays have won his last 13 starts. He struck out nine Guardians over seven scoreless innings on July 26. Cash said he hopes Rasmussen comes close to his ALDS outing, though the writer says that may not be realistic.
In his other 2026 start against Cleveland (April 29), Rasmussen struck out six over five innings, which also clears 5.5. No reported injury or pitch limit was found that would favor the Under.
